$comment: Source prompts for every generated image. Regenerate with: npm run gen:asset -- <name>. Output: apps/web/public/shared/images/<name>.webp, or apps/web/public/games/<game>/images/ when 'game' is set (art used by one game only)
style: Polished stylized 3D cartoon game art for a cheerful casual mobile board-game hub, in the spirit of popular 2015 Vietnamese mobile games. Saturated colors, soft warm lighting from the top-left, chunky rounded shapes, clean edges. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or watermark.
transparentSuffix: Single isolated object on a fully transparent background, centered with generous margin, no ground shadow, no sky, no clouds.

sky.prompt: Wide landscape background: bright daytime sky, gradient from deep azure at the top to pale cyan near the horizon, a sea of soft fluffy white clouds along the bottom third, a few faint distant floating rocks far away. Calm, lots of empty space in the middle for game objects.

cloud-a.prompt: One wide fluffy white cumulus cloud, soft blue-tinted shading underneath.

cloud-b.prompt: One small round puffy white cloud made of three bumps, soft blue-tinted shading underneath.

cloud-curtain.prompt: A tall, dense wall of fluffy white cumulus clouds, portrait orientation (taller than wide), completely filling the left side of the frame from top edge to bottom edge with no gaps or holes. The left edge is cut off flat by the frame; the right edge is a big bumpy puffy cloud outline made of large round billows. Soft blue-tinted shading between the billows, bright white highlights on top. The cloud itself is the object; everything outside the cloud is transparent.

island-caro.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top a giant wooden tic-tac-toe board with chunky red X and blue O pieces, small bushes and a tiny red flag. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

island-cards.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top a round wooden table covered in green felt with a fanned-out hand of oversized playing cards showing only big red heart and black spade suit symbols (no numbers or letters) and a small face-down stack of cards, a red paper lantern on a pole. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

island-dice.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top a colorful four-color race board game (red, blue, green, yellow paths) with a giant white dice with red dots and little horse-shaped game pieces. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

island-chess.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top an oriental Chinese chess (xiangqi) board with round wooden disc pieces in red and black, a small bonsai pine tree and a stone lantern. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

sign.prompt: A blank wide wooden signboard: one horizontal plank of warm orange-brown wood with rounded corners, darker wood border, two small metal nails, hanging from two short ropes. Front view, the plank face is empty and smooth so text can be placed on it.

sign-hover.prompt: The same blank wide wooden signboard (one horizontal plank with rounded corners, two small metal nails, hanging from two short ropes), but highlighted: bright golden-yellow glossy wood with a warm glowing rim and a few small sparkles at the corners. Front view, the plank face is empty and smooth so text can be placed on it.

lock.prompt: A shiny chunky golden padlock, closed, slightly tilted, front view.

tile.prompt: One square light wooden board-game tile seen exactly from the top, flat orthographic top-down view, beveled edges, subtle wood grain, perfectly square, empty face.

piece-x.prompt: A chunky glossy red letter-X shaped game piece, like thick candy or plastic, seen from the top at a slight angle.

piece-o.prompt: A chunky glossy blue ring (donut) shaped game piece, like thick candy or plastic, seen from the top at a slight angle.

speaker-on.prompt: A chunky glossy golden-yellow cartoon loudspeaker icon (speaker cone facing right) with three curved sound-wave arcs in bright white-blue coming out of it, thick dark-brown outline, game UI button icon, side view.

speaker-off.prompt: The same chunky glossy golden-yellow cartoon loudspeaker icon (speaker cone facing right), but instead of sound waves a bold red X next to it meaning muted, thick dark-brown outline, game UI button icon, side view.

orb.prompt: A small glowing magic light orb: a bright round ball of soft warm golden-white light with a glossy core, a gentle soft halo around it and two or three tiny sparkles. Front view.

avatar-boy.prompt: A cute chibi RPG-style character portrait (head and shoulders) of a cheerful young boy with messy black hair, big friendly eyes and a big smile, wearing a small green adventurer scarf, inside a round glossy golden medallion frame with a bright sky-blue background inside the frame. Front view.

avatar-girl.prompt: A cute chibi RPG-style character portrait (head and shoulders) of a cheerful young girl with black hair in two buns, big friendly eyes and a big smile, wearing a small pink adventurer scarf, inside a round glossy golden medallion frame with a bright sky-blue background inside the frame. Front view.

icon-edit.prompt: A chunky glossy cartoon pencil icon, yellow body with pink eraser and sharpened tip, tilted 45 degrees pointing down-left, thick dark-brown outline, game UI icon.

icon-dice.prompt: One chunky glossy white cartoon dice with rounded corners and red dots, slightly tilted showing three faces, thick dark-brown outline, game UI icon.

icon-eye.prompt: One chunky glossy cartoon eye icon, wide open, white eyeball with a big round sky-blue iris and black pupil with a white shine, cute curved eyelashes on top, thick dark-brown outline, front view, game UI icon.

icon-eye-off.prompt: The same chunky glossy cartoon eye icon but closed: a sleepy curved closed eyelid line with cute eyelashes pointing down, and a bold red diagonal slash across it from top-left to bottom-right, thick dark-brown outline, front view, game UI icon.

bird.prompt: A small cute round chubby cartoon bird flying, seen from the front, both wings raised high mid-flap, little orange feet dangling straight down below its body, light blue feathers with a white belly, happy face.

vine.prompt: A single straight vertical ivy vine rope: a thin twisted green-brown vine with small fresh green ivy leaves along its whole length, perfectly vertical, long and thin, running from the very top to the very bottom of the image.

avatar-frame.prompt: An empty round glossy golden medallion frame ring with four small diamond ornaments at top, bottom, left and right; the inside of the ring is completely empty and fully transparent.
